AMENDMENT NO. 1 NOVEMBER 2022 
TO 
IS 15285 : 2016/ISO 5496 : 2006 SENSORY ANALYSIS — METHODOLOGY — 


INITIATION AND TRAINING OF ASSESSORS IN THE DETECTION AND 
RECOGNITION OF ODOURS 


This Amendment No. | is identical with Amendment No. | of ISO 5496 : 2006, ‘Sensory analysis — Methodology 
— Initiation and training of assessors in the detection and recognition of odours’ issued in 2018 by International 
Organization for Standardization (ISO).
